assumptions: Knife charge field (if present) is treated as a 0..1 hold fraction prior only when calibration exists; otherwise hold-until-target heuristic without numeric charge.
Releasing is deferred while charge is estimated insufficient for reach when charge data is available; otherwise release occurs whenever a held knife and target exist.
Expected damage uses damage_per_hit*2 base and up to 6x during a full throw, capped by enemy HP; heuristic over next 30 updates.
Enemy velocity is linearly extrapolated for lead computation by a short time constant; not a guarantee of hit.
Outbound and returning knives are observed only; policy does not steer knives with ordinary input.
visible is ignored as a general mechanic; only dead/vulnerable flags gate target reward.
One proposal is emitted per candidate, satisfying the at-most-four constraint.
author: deepseek
scope: Isaac; Mom's Knife 114 plus known attributes/flight; excludes 69
summary: Implements Mom's Knife policy: tracks held/flying/returning knife phases from observed knives, uses finite-probe calibration as a prior for charge-to-distance mapping, leads targets with observed max speed, releases when estimated charge covers target distance, holds to charge otherwise, and idles while knife is airborne/returning. Movement scored toward distance that lets a full-damage throw land, with reduced weight while charging.
